summary.text: Pro-Life, who legally changed his name from Marvin Richardson, is the Constitution Party nominee for governor of Idaho.

paragraphs.text: Pro-Life says on his campaign website that he ran for lieutenant governor of Idaho in 2022 with the Constitution Party.
He says he had planned to run for governor that year but filed for lieutenant governor after Ammon Bundy, whom he supported, switched from the Republican Party to run as an independent.
He is running for governor in 2026, and he says his wife, Kirsten Faith Richardson, is running for Idaho State Senate in District 14 with the Constitution Party.
